findings.text: blocking: section-only dispatch skips _validated_batch_waits; dispatch.py:1657 stores the pointer before hold_request_for_upstream validates a missing or cyclic ref, so queue-time refusal can leave a queued request behind.

blocking: queue_requests duplicates the production queueing capability owned by reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1657 rather than extending that owner, so its tested batch validation and own-section verdict are absent from ordinary crew dispatch.

item_verdicts.diff: read each of ten commits from 19af48b2b8877f4007c33e4444b3428dbfbbec6e through c44157ab3c6e813005c71fbc69e5c2505ba631ab; queue_admission.py adds the wait graph and parallel queue path, tests add direct-helper assertions, and the evidence fragment records the gate result.
item_verdicts.done_when: prompt.txt:115 requires missing refs and cycles refused before storage and zero added importer failures; tests/test_queue_dag_waits.py checks the separate queue_requests helper, while the paired gate logs show 37 baseline and 38 head failures.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:30 requires cross-project DAG waits from the roadmap section verdict; queue_admission.py:1717 bypasses validation for ordinary section-only dispatches.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md names ten commits, seven changed paths, a 51-pass focused gate, a red mutation, paired importer logs, and the one unresolved raw added failure.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:69-77 plus resume-1-advice.txt:1 and resume-2-advice.txt:1 grant the seven paths in the base-to-head diff, and each changed path is within that extended grant.

justifications.durability: tests/test_queue_dag_waits.py:139-444 has independent expected phases, refusals, obligations, call counts and launch outcomes that would fail if the direct helper regressed, but no added assertion reaches dispatch.py:1657 before a malformed section wait is stored.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_queue_dag_waits.py:190 proves refusal through queue_requests, but base-importers-final.log:1990 and head-importers-final.log:2054 record 37 and 38 failures and the production dispatch path is untested for that refusal.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1353 uses the existing project_section_readiness owner, yet its new _dispatch_nonrun_wait_state at line 1636 splits dispatch behavior from the graph validator and roadmap verdict.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1717 makes ordinary section-only dispatch use declaration checks rather than the per-section verdict and validation promised by the goal.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:2020 adds queue_requests as a duplicate queue writer beside the production owner reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1657, while _dispatch_nonrun_wait_state duplicates readiness logic already owned by reckon/roadmap.py:908.
justifications.scope_discipline: the seven changed paths in git diff 19af48b2..c44157ab are covered by prompt.txt:69-77 and the two scope grants in resume-1-advice.txt:1 and resume-2-advice.txt:1.
